iPhone 17 Pro Max Original Display

This is a genuine Apple Super Retina XDR OLED display assembly for the iPhone 17 Pro Max, pulled from an original device — not an aftermarket or copy screen. The assembly includes the complete factory display stack: the LTPO OLED panel, the integrated touch layer, and the Ceramic Shield 2 front glass with Apple's anti-reflective coating. Every unit is function-tested before sale and comes with an 18-month warranty against display defects.

Display Technology and Specifications

The iPhone 17 Pro Max carries the largest and most advanced panel in the iPhone 17 lineup, and because this unit is pulled from a genuine device, every specification below is the factory specification.

Panel: 6.9-inch Super Retina XDR OLED with LTPO technology and a resolution of 2868×1320 pixels at 460 pixels per inch, with a 2,000,000:1 contrast ratio and true blacks from self-emissive OLED pixels.

ProMotion adaptive refresh: The LTPO panel dynamically scales from 1Hz to 120Hz — full 120Hz smoothness for scrolling and gaming, dropping to 1Hz for static content, which is what enables the Always-On display without significant battery drain. Aftermarket panels are typically fixed at 60Hz and cannot support Always-On; this one behaves exactly like the factory screen because it is one.

Brightness: 1,000 nits typical maximum, 1,600 nits peak for HDR, and 3,000 nits peak outdoor brightness. Combined with the factory anti-reflective coating, the display stays fully readable in direct Dhaka sunlight, where lower-grade panels wash out.

Color and calibration: Full P3 wide color gamut with Apple's factory calibration, True Tone, and HDR support including Dolby Vision.

Front glass: Ceramic Shield 2 with approximately 3× the scratch resistance of the original Ceramic Shield, plus the anti-reflective, fingerprint-resistant coating.

Integrated components: Factory touch digitizer with 120Hz touch sampling, Haptic Touch, ambient light sensing, and the Dynamic Island cutout at correct tolerances for the TrueDepth system.

What "Pulled From a Genuine iPhone" Means?

This display is disassembled from a genuine iPhone 17 Pro Max, which means the panel was manufactured by Apple's display supplier and passed Apple's quality control. A pulled original panel is the closest thing to a factory display that can be purchased — the same OLED substrate, color calibration profile, and touch layer that shipped with the phone. Every unit is inspected and function-tested at our branch before sale.

How It Compares With Aftermarket and Copy Panels ?

The technical gap between grades is measurable. Aftermarket "original quality" panels typically run at a fixed 60Hz, lose Always-On support, reach noticeably lower peak brightness, and often lose True Tone. Copy panels (Incell/TFT) drop further — no ProMotion, washed-out color, weaker touch sampling, and short lifespans. The pulled original panel is the only grade that preserves the complete 17 Pro Max specification: LTPO 1–120Hz, 3,000-nit outdoor brightness, factory calibration, and Ceramic Shield 2. If you want a lower-cost 120Hz option, see our iPhone 17 Pro Max High Quality Display — we sell both grades openly so you can choose with full information.

Compatibility

This display fits the iPhone 17 Pro Max only. It is not compatible with the iPhone 17 Pro (6.3-inch, 2622×1206), iPhone 17, iPhone Air, or iPhone 17e — panel size, resolution, and connectors differ.

iPhone 17 Pro Max Original Display Price in Bangladesh

The original iPhone 17 Pro Max display costs Tk 58,000 at iFixit BD, including an 18-month warranty against display defects and per-unit testing before sale. As the largest and most advanced panel in the iPhone 17 lineup, this is the most premium display part we stock — the price reflects a genuine pulled Apple LTPO panel with the complete factory specification. If your budget calls for a lower price point with 120Hz preserved, our iPhone 17 Pro Max High Quality Display is the alternative, sold openly as an aftermarket grade.

Condition, Warranty, and Ordering

Every unit is a tested, fully functional pull in excellent condition, priced at Tk 58,000 and backed by an 18-month warranty against display defects plus a 30-day money-back guarantee (see our Refund Policy). Order on WhatsApp, call 01613338800, or visit any iFixit BD branch in Dhaka.

What are the common iPhone 17 Pro Max problems we fix?

Battery draining faster than expected

The A19 Pro chip under ProMotion 120Hz and 5G connectivity draws significant power. After 12–18 months of heavy use, capacity drops and you notice the phone losing charge faster and shutting off before reaching 0%. Battery replacement restores full all-day performance and is a same-day repair. iPhone 17 Pro Max battery replacement

Cracked ProMotion OLED display

The 6.9-inch Super Retina XDR ProMotion display is the most expensive single component on this phone. Even a corner drop from moderate height can crack the glass or cause OLED bleed and dead zones. We replace the full assembly with A-grade or Original panels, verify ProMotion and TrueDepth alignment post-repair. iPhone 17 Pro Max screen replacement

Titanium frame damage creating gaps

The titanium frame is harder than steel but thin at the corners. Drops on a corner edge can bend the frame and break the IP68 dust and water seal, allowing moisture and dust to reach internal components. iFixit BD's housing repair service straightens frame deformation and replaces housing when required. iPhone 17 Pro Max housing repair

Triple camera malfunction — blur, lens switching failure, overheating

The three-lens camera system with periscope telephoto is precision hardware. Impact to the camera island, moisture in the lens module, or damaged flex cables can cause blur, failure to switch between lenses, or the camera app crashing during video. We diagnose each camera module independently and replace only what is confirmed faulty. iPhone 17 Pro Max camera repair

USB-C port failing or charging intermittently

Lint, moisture, or physical damage to the USB-C port causes intermittent power delivery, slow data transfer, or no connection. We clean the port during free diagnosis first — replacement is only recommended when the flex cable itself is confirmed damaged. iPhone 17 Pro Max charging issues

Face ID not working after drop or previous repair

The TrueDepth sensor cluster in the Dynamic Island controls Face ID.
